dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a slight concave spline profile from the apex to the mid-fin, transitioning to a linear segment toward the posterior base attachment.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Sharply acute shape with a minimal pixel radius, forming a distinct point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep anterior margin contour, approximately 70-75 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical height is approximately 1.15:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large radius curve resulting in a low-profile, shallow convexity of the anterior-dorsal cranial region.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short pixel length with a broad base, showing a stubby rostrum morphology with limited extension from the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle at the transition point where the shallow melon slope meets the short rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple small, circular white punctate markings across the dark grey lateral and dorsal integument, consistent with epidermal lesions or healed parasitic marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant white pigmentation on the posterior-distal portion of the dorsal fin and a large, high-contrast white patch on the posterior lateral flank extending toward the fluke peduncle.
